name: Laura Tozzi + Ineya & Chichorro Mau
description: Laura Tozzi, Ineya and Chichorro Mau perform live and play a DJ set at Era uma vez em Paris in Porto.
longDescription:
Era uma vez em Paris hosts an evening featuring Laura Tozzi alongside Ineya and Chichorro Mau on 30 November 2026.

The programme starts with a concert at 22:00, followed by a DJ set at 00:30. The event is open to attendees aged 18 and over.
